title: Guild bank

page.reservedTip: Confirmed requests waiting for the hand-out in game.
page.waitingTip: Entries on the waiting list, over all items.

newNotice: New in the bank since the last scan. Sort it once, it stays that way with every scan.

list.stockTip: In the bank at the last scan, without hidden bank tabs.
list.reservedTip: Confirmed requests still waiting for the hand-out.
list.reserveTip: Always stays in the bank and is never offered.
list.settingsSub: Reserve, limit per request and category of this item.
list.waitingTip: On the waiting list, {amount} pieces together.

status.giveTip: Requestable: raiders can ask for it

dialog.reserveTip: This much always stays in the bank and is never offered.
dialog.categoryTip: A group of your own for the list and the request form. Empty = Wowhead's group.
dialog.wholeNumber: Please enter a whole number from 0.

requests.title: Requests
requests.hint: Open and set-aside requests from the stock. Confirming, declining and handing out happen on the card in the orga channel in Discord.
requests.empty: No request is waiting right now.

waitlist.title: Waiting list
waitlist.hint: One list per item: whoever asks first is served first. When stock comes free, the first move up on their own as open requests – with a card in the orga channel and a DM.
waitlist.empty: Nobody is waiting right now. If a raider asks for more than there is, the rest lands here.
waitlist.noDiscordTip: The character name only – no raider profile found, so no DM.
waitlist.name: Raider or character
waitlist.nameHint: A character of a raider profile is matched to that raider (who gets a DM); otherwise the character name stays.
waitlist.importPlaceholder: Name ⇥ Item ⇥ Amount – copied straight from Google Sheets, also separated by ; or ,
waitlist.importHint: New entries go to the end, in the order of the lines. Then whatever is free moves up.

add.title: Add item
add.label: Item ID, Wowhead link or name
add.hint: The ID is in the Wowhead address after item=.
add.note: Not in the bank right now? No problem – the item is created with stock 0 and is offered at once, requests go on the waiting list.
add.noHits: Nothing found. Paste the ID or the link from Wowhead.
add.directHint: Will be created with this ID.
add.known: {name} was already there and is now offered.

tabsDialog.hint: A hidden bank tab does not count as stock: what lies only there shows up nowhere.

empty.title: No guild bank yet
empty.text: The guild bank comes from the addon: open the bank in game, the EventHelper addon scans it, the sync tool uploads the scan.
empty.assign: If a scan has arrived already, it may be waiting to be assigned to this server.
